brief: Holds the two service-level rules of a business process and judges a workflow against them.
detail: The set, named SLA Compliance in the sla domain, carries sla_defined, which wants a step marked critical to have an sla above 0, and sla_compliance, which flags a step whose duration exceeds its sla. A step with no sla is outside the second rule. Check(oWorkflow) answers the findings in the house shape.
receiver:
oWf = new stzWorkflow("order")
oWf.AddStepXT("pack", "Pack")
oWf.SetStepDuration("pack", 30)
oWf.SetStepSLA("pack", 20)
o1 = new stzSLARuleBase()
